newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's Crown Prince meets Israeli Knesset group.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's Crown Prince meets Israeli Knesset group.

text.p: Jordan's Crown Prince on Thursday met two senior Israeli Knesset delegations in Amman to discuss enhancing bilateral ties, an Israeli embassy spokesman said on Thursday.

The Knesset members include an eight-member opposition Labour party delegation headed by Yossi Beilin and another all-party nine-member delegation from the Knesset's economic committee, Israeli embassy spokesman Shalom Tourgman told Reuters.

They are due to later hold talks with Prime Minister Abdul Karim al-Kabariti while the Knesset's economic team will be addressed by Jordan's investment promotion body head and other senior economic officials on ways of developing economic ties, Tourgman added.
A Jordanian official added that the parliamentarians' one-day visit was "part of the government's policy of talking to all parties in Israeli society from across the political spectrum."

Jordan's official ties with Israel have recently been strained by worries over the Jewish state's policy of strengthening settlements in the West Bank, which Amman views as a direct threat to its security.
